source.original_comment: The episode compression logic attempts to compress the oldest episode but doesn't reduce the array's size. The subsequent jq command adds a new episode, causing the array to exceed maxItems: 10. Additionally, the compressed episode object is missing required fields (files_modified, metric_delta).

detection.primary_command: grep -A5 'compress oldest episode' commands/remediate.md | grep -c 'iteration_episodes\[0\]' | tr -d ' '
detection.pattern: episode compression that retains all elements instead of removing oldest

verifiable_metrics.name: Episode compression that does not reduce array size
verifiable_metrics.verification_notes: The old compression pattern keeps all episodes and creates an invalid compressed object

complexity.reasoning: Simple fix: replace compression logic with array slice [1:]

remediation.guidance: Remove the broken compression that creates an invalid summary object. Instead, simply drop the oldest episode with array slicing.
